Only eight countries have ever won the men's football World Cup. Here they are, on one map.

a thread 🧵🗺️
1/ Brazil leads with 5 titles. Germany and Italy have 4 each, Argentina 3. France, Spain and Uruguay have 2, and England 1. Germany includes West Germany. Data: Wikipedia (Oct 2026).
2/ Only three South American countries have ever won: Brazil, Argentina and Uruguay. Uruguay won the very first tournament, in 1930.
3/ Europe's five winners hold 13 of the 23 titles. South America's three hold the other 10. No country from any other continent has won the World Cup.

4/ Europe's own tournament, the men's Euro, spreads the wealth differently. Spain has 4 titles, Germany 3, Italy and France 2. Portugal, the Netherlands, Denmark and Greece have one each. Data: Wikipedia (Oct 2026).
5/ A caveat from the map: the Soviet Union (1960) and Czechoslovakia (1976) are not assigned to their successor states, so Russia and Czechia show no title.
Two maps, one pattern: a handful of football powers win almost everything. Who breaks into the club next? Follow @forummapping for more maps like this.
